message.content:
Servers like this are classified under 8471.41.01, which covers ADP machines containing in the same housing at least a CPU and an input and output unit, whether or not combined. They can also fall under 8471.50.01, which covers processing units. CBP rulings on servers that lack a keyboard or display have typically placed them in 8471.50.0150, processing units other than those of 8471.41/49, as "Other." This server takes user input through a separate personal computer, so it has no integrated input or output unit. That points to 8471.50.0150.
